## Dated note (2026-10-27, after the S6 review)

An erratum to O4 (review W10). It changes nothing in the plan, and O4's text above is left as it was
registered.
- O4 says that R̃'s coefficient ã₁ at ω₀ is "nonzero, with value −d₁ at h = 0". The value should read
  1/d₁ = 1/Δ′(r₊).
- In general ã₁(ω₀) = h²(2κ₊r₊ + L)/Δ′(r₊) = (1 + 2κ₊r₊h² − h²/4)/Δ′(r₊), which is positive for every
  h (the review's sympy check E9).
- The coefficient is nonzero either way, which is all that W6′ uses. `notes/s6-proof.md` §3 does not
  repeat the value.
F6_draft: \item[v1.4] ⟨Month day⟩, 2026 (proposed October 27, 2026 by the P2 stage-S6 assembly, \texttt{problems/\allowbreak P2/\allowbreak notes/\allowbreak s6-report.md}; approved October 27, 2026). P2 only; the other problems are unchanged. \emph{P2 Status.} (a) At the primary pre-registered point $\Lambda M^2=3/50$, $Q/Q_{\max}=999/1000$, for every $\ell$ the only quasinormal modes with $\operatorname{Im}\omega\ge-0.92\,\kappa_-$ ($0.92\,\kappa_-\approx0.55\,\gamma_0$) are $\omega=0$ and the $\ell=0$ near-extremal mode $\omega_*$. Hence $\beta=-\operatorname{Im}\omega_*/\kappa_-\in[0.909380978994805455524933762622\pm3.2\times10^{-31}]$, a two-sided enclosure. This is the stretch goal of revision v1.2. It needed more than the interval-Newton enclosure of the mode named there: every other quasinormal mode had to be excluded down to $\operatorname{Im}\omega=-0.92\,\kappa_-$, and the point $-i\kappa_+$ had to be treated. (b) The point $\omega=-i\kappa_+$ ($\approx-0.823\,i\kappa_-$), where the radial Wronskian has a pole for every $\ell$, is not a resonance of the forward problem near the black-hole exterior used in \cite{hintzvasy2017}. So in this strip the zeros of the radial Wronskian and the resonances used in \cite{hintzvasy2017} coincide, and the two notions of quasinormal mode agree. (c) The proof extends that of v1.3 (b): the large-$\ell$ exclusion, uniform in $\ell\ge20$, now reaches $-0.92\,\kappa_-$; for $\ell\le19$, certified large-$|\operatorname{Re}\omega|$ exclusions and validated argument-principle counts allow for the pole at $-i\kappa_+$; and the point $-i\kappa_+$ is analysed in writing, with interval-certified values for $\ell\le19$. The result is a written proof with machine-checked certificates, independently reviewed October 27, 2026; it is not a fully machine-checked certificate. (d) Not established: the resonance multiplicity of $\omega_*$ (only its order as a zero of the radial Wronskian, $1$, is established); anything below $\operatorname{Im}\omega=-0.92\,\kappa_-$; the second point $Q/Q_{\max}=249/250$; the Einstein--Maxwell problem; any conversion stronger than v1.3 (c). This entry supersedes v1.3 (d) as to the two-sided enclosure of $\beta$.
